correctness.rationale: Claim route PRESET_FALLBACK. Verified exact fallback completion by independent replay: python3 inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK (C1-C6). C1: 192 entries parsed, 36 distinct fusion rings, R17 holders exactly [(17,1),(17,2)] with filed d=[1,cs(9,2),1,cs(9,1),-1,cs(9,4)] — confirmed live file hash-identical to arXiv ancillary (sha256 eeea55e0...). Extra check: no other ring isomorphic under 0-fixing relabeling. C2: exact S (transcribed from SsL6lng upper triangle) satisfies S^2=9I and sum d^2=9 in Q(2cos(2pi/9)) Fraction arithmetic. C3: exact Verlinde reproduces all 216 filed Nij_k, so certificate bites on verified candidate. C4: d4=-1<0 exactly; unitary MTC requires all quantum (=FP) dimensions >0, so no unitary spherical structure. C5: N_1 row sums [1,3,3,2,4,2] (recomputed) give FPdim_1>=1 by Horn-Johnson Thm 8.1.22, while d1=u^2-2<1 via u^3=3u-1 and u>0 (u^2>2 from C2=2cos(80deg)>0, then u^3<3u gives u^2<3) — independent non-FP leg. C6: sigma_8 (zeta9->zeta9^8, order 2) fixes real S and maps spin numerators [0,1,6,4,3,7]->[0,8,3,5,6,2] entrywise, closing the 2-element orbit. Self-duality confirmed (N[i][j][0]=delta). Limitations honestly stated: unitary-only scope, completeness relative to published 192-entry classification, one analytic cos-monotonicity one-liner proved in DRAFT s4. No essential inference or boundary condition fails; proof vs computation distinguished (only Perron positivity invoked as theorem, rest exact).
